newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - SOUTH KOREAN NEWSPAPERS - AUG 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - SOUTH KOREAN NEWSPAPERS - AUG 7.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- The Korean Air Lines boeing 747 that crashed on the Pacific island of Guam on Wednesday carried 231 passengers and 23 crew members, of which 28 survived.

- Korea Air Lines said a medical team was dispatched to bring back to Seoul those survivors who are in good enough state to travel, they are scheduled to arrive in Seoul on Thursday at 3:30 p.m. (0630 GMT).
- Creditor banks of two troubled companies Dainong Corp and Midopa Department Store, headed by SEOULBANK, extended 15.9 billion won in emergency resue loans to the financially-troubled companies.
- Korean Air officials suspect bad weather and the breakdown of an airport landing system caused its Boeing 747 to crash in Guam on Wednesday.
- President Kim Young-sam instructed the cabinet to map out swift and throrough measures to help survivors and victims' families of the Korean Air plane crash in Guam.
